coverage_explanation: Exercises live temperature display, retained and updated historical maxima, repeated button-triggered three-second views, and return to the latest temperature. Temperature changes twice during a history view, including a new peak; a later history request verifies that sampling and maximum tracking continued during that view. Serial timing assertions are omitted because no reporting interval is specified: even a two-second reporting schedule can miss a short sensor state. Consequently, continuous serial reporting and transient serial values are not independently verified. The available check schema also cannot verify Serial.begin(9600). The reference implements both serial requirements.
assumptions: Relies on the disclosed bench defaults: D2 connects to GND when pressed, is released HIGH, and uses INPUT_PULLUP.
LM35 uses its standard 10 mV per degree Celsius transfer function. A1 uses raw ADC readings with the bench-default 5 V reference.
Display precision and rounding are unspecified; numeric ranges allow ordinary integer rounding or truncation.
Sampling rate, serial reporting interval, serial labels, and debounce duration are unspecified. No particular serial cadence or text format is asserted.
Whether the displayed maximum updates immediately during an active history view is unspecified. Checks during the view precede the new peak; the updated peak is checked on a subsequent press.
No overlapping button presses are used. Timing checks allow settling around the specified three-second view.
